title: Activity Forensics Viewer: query builder, cursored pagination, CSV/JSONL export and saved presets
creator: Rohit Patel
description: Build a forensic-grade audit viewer in the Console that lets admins and auditors construct typed queries (actor, action, resource, time-range, outcome), page through results with a forward-only opaque cursor, and export result sets as schema-safe JSONL or redaction-aware CSV. This work ties into RBAC v2 (controls who can view/export), SSO/SAML attribute mapping (to populate actor identities in results), and admin controls (toggle exportability, retention-aware warnings). The UX should prioritize efficient triage (quick filters + time-slicing presets) and make exports safe for compliance reviews (explicit redaction markers, export telemetry).
acceptance_criteria: Console presents a query builder with typed filters: actor (user/email), role, action (enum), resource (catalog path), status/outcome, and start/end time; filters support boolean composition (AND/OR) and quick presets.

Backend search API returns results with stable, opaque forward-only cursors that survive node restarts for up to 15 minutes; cursors cannot be used to enumerate all keys server-side and include TTL and scope metadata.
Pagination supports page sizes of 50/250/1000 rows; UI lazy-loads when scrolling; API supports offset-less next-cursor semantics and a max-result-window protection.

Export flow allows admins with export permission to download JSONL (schema per-event) or CSV (flattened with redaction placeholders). Exports larger than 100k rows are streamed to S3 with a signed one-time download link and export job visible in the console.
Saved query presets: users with appropriate permissions can save, name, and share queries; saved queries inherit RBAC visibility and can be pinned to dashboards.

RBAC v2 enforcements: only principals with 'audit.logs.view' can query; 'audit.logs.export' required for any export; saved query creation requires 'audit.saved.create'. Permissions enforced both in UI and API.
SSO/SAML attribute mapping: actor identity resolves to email and org_role fields when available; missing attributes fallback to internal id with clear UI note.
Export telemetry: each export job records requesting principal, filters used, time of request, and whether redaction was applied; audit export events are themselves logged centrally.
Automated tests cover cursor durability, RBAC checks, export redaction rules, and large-export streaming behavior.
Documentation and Admin guide (Console) with step-by-step for saving queries, sharing, and configuring export retention is published before release.
changes: 2026-02-18: Spike completed; prototype uses DynamoDB + OLAP index for time-slice reads. Found read amplification when time ranges cross shards; mitigations proposed.
2026-02-25: Design sync — decided on forward-only opaque cursors (no server-side offset), TTL 15 minutes; UX will surface 'query changed' if filters mutate during pagination.
2026-03-02: Security review kickoff; raised concern about exported PII. Agreement: export flow requires explicit redaction toggle and admin confirmation modal.
2026-03-05: Backend schema for JSONL finalized; added event schema_version field. JSONL export will be newline-delimited with consistent field set for downstream forensic processing.
2026-03-08: PR #8421 opened for API surface and cursor implementation; requires load-testing before merge.
2026-03-10: UX updated: quick presets added (Last 1h, Last 24h, Custom window) and 'time-slice' helper to split large ranges into multiple export jobs.
testing_notes: Load test plan: synthetic 100k events/hour per org for 2 hours; validate cursor durability and time-slice throughput.

Edge case: perform export while retention job deletes mid-query — expected behavior: export job snapshots matched event ids at start_time; deletions after snapshot do not cause error but missing data is annotated.
Unit tests: RBAC middleware assertions, SAML attribute mapping stubs, and JSONL schema conformance.
Security tests: pen-test export flow to ensure signed download links expire and are single-use.
ux_notes: Show role-aware hints in the query builder (e.g., masked emails for non-admin viewers).
Saved query sharing: modal to choose teams/orgs; show effective visibility based on RBAC v2 rules.
Export status: toast + export jobs list with progress bars when streaming to S3.
Accessibility: ensure keyboard-first query composition and ARIA labels for filter chips.
migration_plan: Phase 1 (canary): enable for 10% of orgs with no export rights; monitor query latency and cursor TTL metrics.
Phase 2: enable exports for pilot enterprise customers behind feature flag; collect feedback on redaction rules.
Phase 3: full rollout with console docs and webinar for Security/IT teams.
